nodes.description: ERC20Token.totalSupply public state variable holding the total token amount.
Ownable.owner public address holding privileged control of the contract.
StandardToken.balances mapping(address=>uint256) storing token balances.
StandardToken.allowed nested mapping(address=>address=>uint256) storing allowances.
WOS.deadlineToFreedTeamPool timestamp gate before which the team pool cannot be released.
WOS.INITIAL_SUPPLY constant total supply value.
WOS.wosPoolForSecondStage frozen token pool for stage two.
WOS.wosPoolForThirdStage frozen token pool for stage three.
WOS.wosPoolToTeam frozen token pool reserved for the team reward.
WOS.wosPoolToWosSystem frozen pool for community incentives and developer ecosystem.
WOS.INTERVAL_TIME two year interval constant.
Caller address supplied by the transaction and used for ownership, balances and pool release.
Miner-controllable block timestamp used in the team pool deadline check.
Ownable() constructor that assigns the deployer as owner.
onlyOwner modifier enforcing require(msg.sender == owner).
Ownable.transferOwnership(address) restricted to the current owner.
SafeMathLib.add(uint256,uint256) with overflow assertion.
SafeMathLib.sub(uint256,uint256) with underflow assertion.
SafeMathLib.mul(uint256,uint256) with overflow assertion.
SafeMathLib.div(uint256,uint256) with zero assertions.
StandardToken.transfer(address,uint256) moving balances from msg.sender to _to.
StandardToken.transferFrom(address,address,uint256) moving balances using allowances.
StandardToken.approve(address,uint256) writing allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
StandardToken.balanceOf(address) view returning balances[_owner].
StandardToken.allowance(address,address) view returning allowed[_owner][_spender].
WOS() constructor distributing totalSupply, allocating balances and freezing pools.
Owner-only release of wosPoolForSecondStage into balances[msg.sender].
Owner-only release of wosPoolForThirdStage into balances[msg.sender].
Owner-only, timestamp-gated release of wosPoolToTeam into balances[msg.sender].
Owner-only release of wosPoolToWosSystem into balances[msg.sender].
View returning the remaining second stage frozen pool.
Payable fallback function that always reverts.
Parameter _owner of balanceOf/allowance.
Parameter _to of transfer/transferFrom recipient address.
Parameter _value of transfer amount.
Parameter _from of transferFrom source address.
Parameter _spender of approve/allowance.
Parameter newOwner of transferOwnership.
Parameter a of the SafeMathLib arithmetic helpers.
Parameter b of the SafeMathLib arithmetic helpers.
Local variable peerSupply in the WOS constructor holding totalSupply/100.
Balance credit balances[_to] = balances[_to].add(_value) performed in transfer.
Allowance decrement allowed[_from][msg.sender].sub(_value) in transferFrom.
require(block.timestamp >= deadlineToFreedTeamPool) timestamp gate in freedWosPoolToTeam.

edges.reason: Ownable constructor assigns owner = msg.sender, giving the caller privileged role.
balances mapping is indexed by msg.sender in transfer and approve paths.
allowed mapping is indexed by msg.sender in approve and transferFrom.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender against owner.
transferOwnership caller identity determines authorization via onlyOwner.
transfer reads and debits balances[msg.sender].
transferFrom checks allowed[_from][msg.sender] for allowance.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
WOS constructor credits the largest share of balances to msg.sender.
freedWosPoolForSecondStage credits balances[msg.sender] under onlyOwner.
freedWosPoolForThirdStage credits balances[msg.sender] under onlyOwner.
freedWosPoolToTeam credits balances[msg.sender] under onlyOwner and a timestamp gate.
freedWosPoolToWosSystem credits balances[msg.sender] under onlyOwner.
block.timestamp is compared against deadlineToFreedTeamPool, a timestamp dependency.
freedWosPoolToTeam outcome depends on the miner-controllable block.timestamp.
The timestamp requirement is a block.timestamp dependent access condition.
Ownable constructor writes the owner state variable.
Ownable constructor reads msg.sender to seed owner.
onlyOwner reads the owner state variable to authorize callers.
onlyOwner reads msg.sender for the equality check.
transferOwnership overwrites the owner state variable.
transferOwnership execution is gated by the onlyOwner modifier.
transfer mutates balances entries through add and sub.
transfer delegates credit arithmetic to SafeMathLib.add.
transfer delegates debit arithmetic to SafeMathLib.sub.
transfer executes the balance credit unsafe operation on the recipient.
transferFrom mutates sender and recipient balances through add and sub.
transferFrom decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
transferFrom delegates credit arithmetic to SafeMathLib.add.
transferFrom delegates debit arithmetic to SafeMathLib.sub.
transferFrom executes the allowance subtraction unsafe operation.
approve writes the allowed mapping entry for the spender.
balanceOf reads balances[_owner] without mutation.
allowance reads allowed[_owner][_spender] without mutation.
WOS constructor sets totalSupply from INITIAL_SUPPLY.
WOS constructor reads INITIAL_SUPPLY to size distributions.
WOS constructor credits balances[msg.sender] with the first stage allocation.
WOS constructor freezes the second stage pool.
WOS constructor freezes the third stage pool.
WOS constructor freezes the team pool.
WOS constructor freezes the WOS system pool.
WOS constructor uses SafeMathLib.mul for pool sizing.
WOS constructor uses SafeMathLib.div to compute peerSupply.
WOS constructor stores totalSupply/100 into the peerSupply local variable.
freedWosPoolForSecondStage drains and zeroes wosPoolForSecondStage.
freedWosPoolForSecondStage credits balances[msg.sender] with the frozen pool.
freedWosPoolForSecondStage uses SafeMathLib.add for the credit.
freedWosPoolForSecondStage is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
freedWosPoolForThirdStage drains and zeroes wosPoolForThirdStage.
freedWosPoolForThirdStage credits balances[msg.sender] with the frozen pool.
freedWosPoolForThirdStage uses SafeMathLib.add for the credit.
freedWosPoolForThirdStage is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
freedWosPoolToTeam drains and zeroes wosPoolToTeam.
freedWosPoolToTeam credits balances[msg.sender] with the team pool.
freedWosPoolToTeam reads deadlineToFreedTeamPool for its timing condition.
freedWosPoolToTeam uses SafeMathLib.add for the credit.
freedWosPoolToTeam is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
freedWosPoolToTeam executes the timestamp dependency unsafe operation.
freedWosPoolToWosSystem drains and zeroes wosPoolToWosSystem.
freedWosPoolToWosSystem credits balances[msg.sender] with the frozen pool.
freedWosPoolToWosSystem uses SafeMathLib.add for the credit.
freedWosPoolToWosSystem is guarded by the onlyOwner modifier.
balanceWosPoolForSecondStage returns the wosPoolForSecondStage value.
The _owner parameter supplies the balanceOf lookup key.
The _to parameter is the transfer recipient address.
The _value parameter is the transfer amount.
The _from parameter is the transferFrom source address.
The _spender parameter is the approved spender address.
The newOwner parameter becomes the new owner value.
The a parameter is the first operand of the SafeMath helpers.
The b parameter is the second operand of the SafeMath helpers.
The peerSupply local is consumed by the WOS constructor allocations.

normalization_plan.reason: The _owner parameter only exists to index balances inside the balanceOf/allowance view functions.
The _to parameter is a pure input of the transfer routine and carries no independent semantics.
The _value parameter is a pure input of the transfer arithmetic.
The _from parameter is a pure input of the transferFrom allowance and balance logic.
The _spender parameter is a pure input used to key the allowed mapping in approve.
The newOwner parameter only exists to be assigned to the owner state variable.
The a parameter is a scalar operand of the SafeMath library arithmetic helpers.
The b parameter is a scalar operand of the SafeMath library arithmetic helpers.
The peerSupply local is a temporary intermediate consumed entirely within the WOS constructor.
